⚠️ Underwriting Eligibility CriteriaCriterios de Elegibilidad de Suscripción

Conditions extracted directly from product application PDFs that may render an applicant ineligible.

STOPAbsolute Disqualifiers — All Products ▼
A YES to any of the following = application stopped. No coverage can be issued for any product tier.
Ever diagnosed / treated / advised for:
  • Congestive heart failure (CHF) or cardiomyopathy
  • Memory loss, Alzheimer's disease, senile dementia or dementia
  • Heart defibrillator implant
  • Two or more instances of internal cancer(s)
  • Terminal illness — disease expected to result in death within 24 months
  • Organ transplant (other than corneal), bone marrow or stem cell transplant
  • Kidney failure or dialysis
  • Amputation due to diabetic complications
  • Muscular dystrophy, ALS (Lou Gehrig's), Huntington's disease, cystic fibrosis or pulmonary fibrosis
  • Mental incapacity or Down's syndrome
  • Diabetes diagnosed at age 9 or younger
  • AIDS, AIDS Related Complex (ARC), HIV positive, or any immune system disorder
Within the last 2 years:
  • Uncontrolled diabetes or uncontrolled high blood pressure
  • Diabetic coma or insulin shock
  • Schizophrenia
  • Alcohol or drug abuse / dependency on prescription medication
  • Illegal use of drugs
Within the last year:
  • Confined to a hospital for more than 5 days total
  • Pending surgery or hospitalization advised but not yet performed
  • Used oxygen due to a medical condition
  • Unable to care for yourself, bedridden, or in a nursing home / hospice / assisted living
SIMPL P&SConditions Disqualifying Preferred & Standard Tiers ▼
A YES here blocks Preferred and Standard. Applicant may still qualify for SIMPL Modified (MWL).
Within the past 3 years:
  • Lymphoma, leukemia, or any form of cancer (incl. melanoma, excl. basal cell skin cancer)
  • Chemotherapy or radiation treatment (or advice to receive it)
Within the past 2 years:
  • Angina (chest pain), heart attack, heart/circulatory surgery or disease, heart valve disorder
  • Pacemaker or stent placement
  • Stroke (excluding TIA/mini-stroke) or paralysis
  • Aneurysm, brain tumor, or sickle cell anemia
  • Diabetic complications: nephropathy (kidney), neuropathy (nerve/circulatory) or retinopathy (eye)
  • Chronic hepatitis, Hepatitis C, cirrhosis of the liver, or chronic pancreatitis
  • Kidney disease or Systemic Lupus (SLE)
  • Multiple sclerosis or Parkinson's disease
  • Required use of a walker, wheelchair, or electric scooter due to chronic illness
  • Convicted of or guilty plea to a felony/misdemeanor, or charge currently pending
An Rx PreCheck is run — a red result for a tier = automatic decline for that tier.
SIMPL MODConditions Disqualifying Modified (MWL) Tier ▼
If applicant failed Part 2 (P&S) AND answers YES here — no coverage can be issued at all.
Ever diagnosed / treated / advised for:
  • COPD, chronic bronchitis, emphysema
  • Irregular heartbeat or atrial fibrillation
  • Peripheral vascular disease or peripheral artery disease
  • Insulin-dependent diabetes (insulin use before age 25)
Within the past 2 years:
  • Epileptic seizures
  • Transient Ischemic Attack (TIA / mini-stroke)
⚠️ SIMPL Modified provides a graded death benefit for the first 3 years. AD&D and ADB riders are not available on this tier.
SPWLLiberty Legacy SPWL — Ineligibility Conditions ▼
Section A — Any YES = No Coverage Will Be Issued
  • Needs assistance with Activities of Daily Living (bathing, dressing, eating, toileting, transferring, taking medications)
  • Insulin shock, diabetic coma, amputation due to diabetes; insulin before age 40; diabetes before age 25
  • Organ transplant; terminal illness (expected death within 12 months); currently hospitalized, bedridden, or in hospice
  • Chronic kidney disease / dialysis, kidney or liver failure, congestive heart failure, cardiomyopathy
  • Organic brain syndrome, Alzheimer's, dementia, ALS, schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, or mental incapacity
  • AIDS, ARC, HIV positive, or any immune deficiency disorder
  • More than one occurrence or any metastasis of cancer (excl. basal/squamous cell skin cancer); currently in cancer treatment
  • Within past 24 months: declined or postponed for life/health insurance; convicted of felony; DUI conviction
  • Within past 24 months: internal cancer, leukemia, lymphoma, melanoma, Hodgkin's, Parkinson's, stroke, TIA, cirrhosis, liver disease, attempted suicide, alcohol/drug abuse
  • Within past 24 months: COPD, emphysema, chronic bronchitis, or required oxygen
  • Within past 24 months: angina, heart attack, heart/vascular surgery, uncontrolled high blood pressure, or circulation procedures
  • Within past 24 months: neuromuscular/brain disease (cerebral palsy, MS, muscular dystrophy, cystic fibrosis), lupus (SLE), or paralysis of 2+ extremities
  • Height/weight outside the maximum underwriting range
Section B — YES may still allow Standard rate (not Preferred):
  • Within past 48 months: lymphoma, melanoma, leukemia, internal cancer, Hodgkin's, Parkinson's, stroke, TIA, cirrhosis, or liver disease
  • Within past 36 months: angioplasty, stent, angina, heart attack, heart/vascular surgery, or circulation procedure
  • Within past 36 months: COPD, emphysema, chronic bronchitis, or required oxygen
  • Within past 36 months: diabetic complications (neuropathy, retinopathy, or uncontrolled blood sugar)
  • Within past 24 months: confined 3+ times to hospital, nursing facility, convalescent care, or mental facility
📊 Expected outcomes: ~70% Preferred, ~15% Standard, ~15% declined. No medical exam required — telephonic underwriting only.
FIRST STEPSFirst Steps For Life — Children's Eligibility ▼
Issue ages: 15 days to 17 years. Uses the same SIMPL application — all SIMPL disqualifiers apply to the child. "If all health questions are correctly answered 'No,' the insured child is eligible."
Children's/Grandchildren's Rider — Supplemental Application:
  • Cancer, diabetes, heart or circulatory disorder
  • Mental or nervous disorder, mental retardation, cerebral palsy, muscular dystrophy, spina bifida
  • Cystic fibrosis, un-operated heart defects, epilepsy, asthma
  • Disorders of muscles/bones, anemia, or disorders of blood, bladder, kidneys, liver, or lungs
  • AIDS, ARC, HIV positive, or any immune deficiency disorder
  • Alcohol, heroin, cocaine, narcotics, hallucinogens, tranquilizers, barbiturates, or amphetamines (unless prescribed)
ALLCross-Cutting Factors — All Products ▼
  • False statements / misrepresentation: Knowingly presenting a false statement may be a criminal offense. Coverage may be voided or cancelled.
  • MIB & Rx Check: All applications run through the Medical Information Bureau and a prescription drug database. Undisclosed conditions found may result in denial.
  • Coverage limit before delivery: Total Liberty Bankers coverage taking effect before policy delivery cannot exceed $25,000 (includes riders, in-force, and applied-for coverage).
  • Height/Weight chart: Applicants must fall within the minimum/maximum weight for their height. Exceeding the maximum = no coverage issued.
  • Citizenship: SPWL application requires U.S. citizenship or permanent residency.
  • No medical exam required: All products use simplified / telephonic underwriting only — no physical exam or APS ordered.
